name: White City Dating Sim (Proof of Concept / Game Jam Version)
source:
An inanimate object dating sim created in one day for [url=http://electricopolis.tumblr.com/post/47453738354/pphsjam-roundup-post]PPHSJAM[/url].

Concept was later used to create a full game of the same name.
translation:
一天内创建的无生命物体约会模拟游戏[url=http://electricopolis.tumblr.com/post/47453738354/pphsjam-roundup-post]PPHSJAM[/url]。

概念后来被用来创建同名的完整游戏。
